pieces.vo: Where is the race car, using only its cameras?
pieces.cap: Where is the race car, using only its cameras?

pieces.vo: camloc estimates position and heading ten times a second around Yas Marina, with no GNSS, no LiDAR, and no starting pose.
pieces.cap: x, y and heading at 10 Hz around Yas Marina. No GNSS, no LiDAR, no starting pose.

pieces.vo: On held-out night laps, where the map and every calibration exclude the scored lap, the position error is zero point five one metres, lateral zero point three, and ninety-five percent of poses are within one metre.
pieces.cap: Held-out night laps, map and calibration without the scored lap: 0.51 m position, 0.30 m lateral, 95.1 % within 1 m.

pieces.vo: These are held-out training laps, not a hidden-test result.
pieces.cap: Held-out training laps, not a hidden-test result.

pieces.vo: Why not just odometry? Wheel speeds and steering alone drift more than a hundred metres, even from the true start.
pieces.cap: Odometry alone: 107 m RMSE over the run, even from the true start pose.

pieces.vo: Three of the seven cameras, front left, front right and rear, carry the map fixes.
pieces.cap: fl, fr and r carry the map fixes.

pieces.vo: Think of a rally co-driver with a pace-note book.
pieces.cap: Think of a rally co-driver with a pace-note book.

pieces.vo: Between landmarks, they count distance and turns from the car's own speed and steering. That is our odometry: smooth, but it drifts.
pieces.cap: Between landmarks they count from speed and steering: odometry, smooth but drifting.

pieces.vo: When they recognise a landmark from the notes, they snap back to the map. That is our geo-referenced feature map, solved by PnP on each camera.
pieces.cap: A recognised landmark snaps them back to the map: ORB map + PnP per camera.

pieces.vo: Their judgement decides which sightings to trust and rejects look-alikes: cross-camera consensus, a statistical gate, and a Kalman filter.
pieces.cap: Judgement rejects look-alikes: consensus, NIS gate, EKF.

pieces.vo: And dropped mid-stage with no position, they look around until sightings agree, commit provisionally, and change their mind if the evidence says so.
pieces.cap: Dropped mid-stage: look until sightings agree, commit provisionally, switch if needed.

pieces.vo: Every block earns its place with a measurement.
pieces.cap: Every block earns its place with a measurement.

pieces.vo: We chose classical methods, not deep learning: we have one night of data, so there is nothing to overfit, and it runs deterministically in about twenty-five to forty milliseconds on a laptop CPU, against a hundred millisecond budget.
pieces.cap: Classical, not deep learning: one night of data, deterministic, 24–39 ms vs a 100 ms budget.

pieces.vo: The map gives absolute metres: it takes the error from over a hundred metres to under one.
pieces.cap: The map gives absolute metres: 107 m down to under 1 m.

pieces.vo: Odometry and the filter bridge the gaps: thirty seconds without any fix costs about two point seven metres, and it recovers.
pieces.cap: Odometry + EKF bridge gaps: 30 s without fixes costs ~2.7 m, then recovers.

pieces.vo: The gate makes wrong landmarks harmless: injecting two percent of fixes ten metres wrong leaves lap four unchanged.
pieces.cap: Gating: 2 % of fixes injected 10 m wrong, lap 4 still 0.457 m.

pieces.vo: And strict validation is why these numbers can be trusted: the map and every calibration are rebuilt without the scored lap, and the official scorer does the scoring.
pieces.cap: Strict validation: map + calibration rebuilt without the scored lap; official scorer.

pieces.vo: A live run on held-out lap four. The map and the calibration were rebuilt without that lap, and no start pose is given.
pieces.cap: Live run, held-out lap 4: map + calibration rebuilt without it, no start pose.

pieces.vo: About a thousand frames, at around twenty-five milliseconds each, locked on the first frame.
pieces.cap: 1060 frames at ~25 ms each (25 s of processing cut), locked on the first frame.

pieces.vo: The official scorer reports zero point four six metres, and ninety-six point seven percent of poses within one metre on this lap.
pieces.cap: Official scorer: 0.461 m position RMSE, 96.7 % within 1 m on lap 4.

pieces.vo: Here is that lap replayed at four times speed. The blue estimate stays on the ground-truth ring, which is drawn for display only.
pieces.cap: Lap 4 at 4x speed. Ground truth drawn for display only.

pieces.vo: The error stays well under a metre, with short spikes above it, and the running error ends at zero point four six metres.
pieces.cap: Mostly well under 1 m, short spikes above; final RMSE 0.461 m.

pieces.vo: Across the three held-out laps: zero point six, zero point four six, and zero point four two metres.
Each development step was kept only if the held-out error went down, from one point zero six to zero point five one metres.
pieces.cap: Each step kept only if held-out error fell: 1.06 to 0.51 m.

pieces.vo: No start pose. At seventy percent of lap six, two cameras agree on a look-alike place, thirteen and a half metres off.
pieces.cap: Lap 6 at 70 %: two cameras agree on a look-alike place 13.6 m off.

pieces.vo: Like a co-driver who realises they misread the landmark: within a third of a second, three rejected fixes agree with each other elsewhere, and the filter switches to them.
pieces.cap: The co-driver misread the landmark: within 0.3 s, three rejected fixes agree elsewhere, so it switches.

pieces.vo: Two accepted fixes then confirm it.
pieces.cap: Two accepted fixes confirm it.

pieces.vo: Over sixteen mid-lap starts, every run locks within two seconds, and all sixteen end correct.
pieces.cap: 16 mid-lap starts: lock within 1.8 s, 16 / 16 end correct.

pieces.vo: We know exactly where it degrades, and by how much. Without map fixes, the error grows to about two point seven metres over thirty seconds, and five over a minute.
pieces.cap: Known limits: without map fixes, 2.7 m over 30 s and 5.2 m over 60 s (lap 4).

pieces.vo: On the organisers' daylight sample, which has no ground truth, we only checked structure: it locks at zero point six seconds and covers every second, with few fixes.
pieces.cap: Daylight sample, no ground truth: structural check only. Locks at 0.6 s, 74 / 74 s covered, few fixes.

pieces.vo: And it all runs with one command, on both topic layouts, on a CPU. Code, experiment log and validation protocol are in the repository.
pieces.cap: One command, both topic layouts, CPU only. github.com/Mulaydm10/yas-camloc
